name: gizza-ai/generate-hotp
summary: Generate an HOTP (counter-based 2FA) code from a secret

tool.description: Generate a counter-based one-time code (HOTP, RFC 4226) from a base32 secret and a counter value. HOTP is event-based: each code is tied to a counter you increment per use (unlike TOTP, which uses the current time). digits (6-8, default 6) and algorithm (sha1 default / sha256 / sha512) are configurable. Returns the code for that counter. Runs locally — the secret never leaves the device.

secret.description: The HOTP shared secret, base32-encoded (spaces and case are ignored).

counter.description: The counter value (a non-negative integer); incremented for each new code.

digits.description: Number of digits in the code (6, 7, or 8; default 6).

algorithm.description: HMAC hash algorithm (default sha1, the standard for authenticator apps).
